error.nas_password_changed: Sign in again · NAS password changed
error.device_removed: Signed out · This PC was removed from Loft
pair.title: Pair with your gateway
pair.body: On the gateway, run loft-gateway pair. Open the link it shows on this PC, or paste it here.
pair.manual_body: Type the gateway's address and one of its key fingerprints. loft-gateway pair shows both. The fingerprint is how Loft checks it's really your gateway, so there's no setup without it.
pair.replace: This PC is paired with {old}. Pairing with {new} signs you out of {old} on this PC.
sign_in.title: Sign in to your NAS
sign_in.body: Use the username and password you already have on the NAS. Sign in at home the first time, so your password never passes through anyone else's servers. After that, Loft works from anywhere.
sign_in.account_help: Loft shows every shared folder this account can open. No account yet? Ask whoever runs the NAS.
sign_in.not_at_home: You're not at home right now. Connect to the home network for the first sign-in. After that, Loft works from anywhere.
sign_in.wrong_password: That username and password didn't work on the NAS. Check them and try again.
sign_in.account_not_allowed: This gateway doesn't allow that account. Sign in with your own NAS account.
sign_in.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
folder.title: Choose your Loft folder
folder.body: This folder on the NAS becomes Loft in Explorer. You can change it later in Settings.
done.title: You're all set.
done.body: Loft is in Explorer's navigation pane. Your files show up right away and download when you open them. To keep something on this PC for offline use, right-click it and choose Always keep on this device.
settings.home_only: Away: not set up (home network only)
settings.check_for_updates: Check for updates once a day
settings.updates_help: Loft asks loft.incremental.no if there's a newer version. It sends nothing about you, this PC or your files.
settings.start_at_sign_in: Open Loft when I sign in to Windows
settings.storage_help: Files you keep on this device are never removed. Anything else can be cleared from this PC once it's safely on the NAS.
settings.cache_help: When downloaded files take up more than this, Loft clears the ones you haven't opened for the longest. They stay on the NAS. Files you keep on this device don't count.
settings.office_note: Office AutoSave only works with OneDrive, so save with Ctrl+S. If something crashes, AutoRecover in Office still helps.
